title.zh-TW: 終端機 Code Mode 支援四大雲端平台
title.en: Code Mode in Terminal Supports Four Cloud Platforms

body.zh-TW: 企業或開發者透過雲端服務跑終端機工作階段，過去無法開啟 Code Mode。Amazon Bedrock 與 Google Cloud's Agent Platform 現已加入支援。Microsoft Foundry 和 Claude Platform on AWS 同樣可以使用這個模式。⟦就像家裡換了不同家電力公司供電，插頭插上去後原本的電器照樣運轉，不用為了換供應商重買一整套設備。⟧
body.en: Enterprises and developers running terminal sessions through cloud services previously could not enable Code Mode. Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud's Agent Platform are now supported. Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS can use this mode as well. ⟦Think of switching your home to a different electric utility: once you plug in, your existing appliances keep running without buying a whole new set of equipment.⟧

items.original: Added Code Mode support in terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS

title.zh-TW: 閘道器新增 oidc.groups_jsonpath
title.en: Gateway Adds oidc.groups_jsonpath

body.zh-TW: 身分驗證回傳的群組資料如果包在物件清單裡，現在能直接從符合條件的項目挑出來讀取。管理員在 Claude apps 閘道器加上 `oidc.groups_jsonpath` 這個鍵，就能用精簡版的 JSONPath（從資料結構挑出欄位的查詢語法）讀取群組。這套查詢語法支援 RFC 9535 標準的一小部分功能。⟦像收到一長串混合明細的帳單，以前得整份從頭翻找，現在拿一張鏤空板蓋上去，只會露出符合條件的群組名稱。⟧
body.en: When authentication returns group data wrapped inside a list of objects, you can now read it directly from matching entries. Administrators can add the `oidc.groups_jsonpath` key to the Claude apps gateway to read groups with a compact version of JSONPath (a query syntax for picking fields from a data structure). This query syntax supports a small subset of the RFC 9535 standard. ⟦Picture receiving a long itemized bill where you used to scan the whole page, and now placing a stencil over it so only the matching group names show through.⟧

items.original: Added `oidc.groups_jsonpath` to the Claude apps gateway, to read groups from the matching entries of a list of objects with a small subset of JSONPath (RFC 9535)

title.zh-TW: claude doctor 新增 API 連線檢測
title.en: claude doctor Adds API Connectivity Check

body.zh-TW: 連不上 API 想查連線狀況，可以執行 `claude doctor`。這個診斷指令新增了 API 連線檢查區段，會直接告訴你連不連得到 API。能通或失敗時，畫面會附上 HTTP 狀態碼或錯誤訊息；如果沒有執行測試，也會說明跳過的原因。⟦好比汽車保養廠接上的檢測儀，插上去不只告訴你引擎順不順，還會印出故障代碼，或是直接註明這趟沒測哪一項。⟧
body.en: If you cannot reach the API and want to check the connection, you can run `claude doctor`. This diagnostic command adds an API connectivity check section that tells you directly whether the API is reachable. When it succeeds or fails, the screen includes the HTTP status code or error message; if the test did not run, it also explains why it was skipped. ⟦Like a diagnostic scanner at an auto repair shop, plugging it in not only tells you if the engine runs smoothly, it also prints the fault code or notes which item was not tested this time.⟧

items.original: Added an API connectivity section to `claude doctor` that reports whether the API can be reached, with the HTTP status or the error, or says why it wasn't tested

title.zh-TW: 點擊口述自動停止時會顯示提醒
title.en: Tap-Mode Dictation Shows Notice on Auto-Stop

body.zh-TW: 講到一半才發現麥克風早就停了，語音輸入也可能遇到這種窘境。現在使用點擊開啟的語音口述模式，只要連續 15 秒沒辨識到說話內容，或是達到 2 分鐘單次上限而自動結束，畫面上都會跳出提醒通知。⟦就像投幣式卡拉 OK 時間到就停止收音並響鈴，現在口述自動停止也會顯示提醒。⟧
body.en: Realizing mid-sentence that the microphone stopped long ago can happen with voice input too. Now when using tap-to-start voice dictation, a reminder notice pops up on screen whenever it ends automatically after 15 seconds without recognized speech or upon hitting the 2-minute per-session limit. ⟦A coin-operated karaoke booth cuts off the mic and rings a bell when time is up, and dictation now displays a notice when it stops on its own.⟧

items.original: Added a notice when tap-mode voice dictation stops by itself, after 15 seconds without recognized speech or at its 2-minute limit

title.zh-TW: 新增環境變數避開代理截斷壓縮回應
title.en: New Environment Variable Avoids Proxy Truncating Compressed Responses

body.zh-TW: 公司或團隊的網路代理如果會把壓縮過的模型回應半路切斷，對話常常收到一半就失敗。現在可以設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_RESPONSE_COMPRESSION`，要求改送未壓縮的回應內容來避開截斷。不過目前還不建議在自託管執行器（公司或個人自己架設來跑自動化任務的機器）或遠端控制開啟這個選項。⟦跟寄海運一樣，怕真空壓縮袋被劃破時改用原箱寄出，只是特定路線暫時不適用。⟧
body.en: If a company or team network proxy cuts off compressed model responses mid-stream, conversations often fail halfway through. You can now set the environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_RESPONSE_COMPRESSION` to request uncompressed response content and avoid truncation. However, enabling this option is not yet recommended on self-hosted runners (machines set up by a company or individual to run automated tasks) or Remote Control. ⟦Just as with ocean freight, when you worry a vacuum-sealed bag might get slashed, you ship in the original box instead, though certain routes are off-limits for now.⟧

items.original: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_RESPONSE_COMPRESSION` to ask for uncompressed model responses behind a proxy that cuts compressed ones off; not advised yet for self-hosted runners or Remote Control

title.zh-TW: 閘道器支援經代理傳送 IdP 主機名稱
title.en: Gateway Supports Sending IdP Hostname via Proxy

body.zh-TW:
管理 Claude apps 閘道器若開啟 `oidc.use_proxy: true`，設定檔寫法如下：

`{"oidc": {"use_proxy": true}}`

新增的環境變數（啟動程式時讀取的設定）可設為 `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_IDP_CONNECT_BY_HOSTNAME=1`。

即使設有 `NO_PROXY`（略過代理的名單），登入請求仍會把 HTTPS 身分提供者的主機名稱傳給代理。⟦好比貨運雖然列了「直達免經轉運站」的清單，但貼上這張特別標籤後，遇到加密包裹還是會把收件地址交給轉運站處理。⟧
body.en:
When managing a Claude apps gateway with `oidc.use_proxy: true` enabled, write the configuration file as follows:

`{"oidc": {"use_proxy": true}}`

The new environment variable (a setting read when starting a program) can be set to `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_IDP_CONNECT_BY_HOSTNAME=1`.

Even with `NO_PROXY` (the list of addresses that bypass the proxy) set, sign-in requests still pass the HTTPS identity provider's hostname to the proxy. ⟦Imagine a freight service with a "direct delivery, skip the transfer hub" list: once this special label is attached, encrypted packages still hand their destination address to the transfer hub.⟧

items.original: Added `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_IDP_CONNECT_BY_HOSTNAME=1` for Claude apps gateways: with `oidc.use_proxy: true`, sign-in requests hand the proxy an `https` IdP's hostname even with `NO_PROXY` set

title.zh-TW: 模型請求追蹤紀錄補齊用量與模型資訊
title.en: Model Request Traces Add Usage and Model Details

body.zh-TW:
給用遙測追蹤服務的管理員與開發者：過去看紀錄時，常看不到實際執行動作、回應的是哪一版或花了多少資源。現在這類追蹤紀錄會補齊操作名稱、實際回應的模型，以及各項用量數據。

統計輸入用量時，提示詞快取（把重複內容暫存起來直接讀取）也會一併算進去。

這類模型請求追蹤紀錄中的輸入 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數量確實包含這塊用量。

⟦跟核對維修工單一樣，以前單子上只寫有派工，現在把執行項目、用了哪台機具，以及包含預備材料在內的耗用量都一併列清楚。⟧
body.en:
For administrators and developers using telemetry tracing: when checking logs in the past, you often could not see the actual operation, which version responded, or how many resources were spent. Now these trace records include the operation name, the model that actually responded, and usage metrics.

When counting input usage, prompt caching (temporarily storing repeated content for direct reading) is included as well.

The input token (text unit processed and billed by AI) count in these model request trace records does include this usage.

⟦Comparing this to checking a maintenance work order, the form used to say only that a job was dispatched, whereas now it lists the task performed, which machine was used, and the consumption including spare materials.⟧

items.original: Added `gen_ai.usage.*`, `gen_ai.response.model` and `gen_ai.operation.name` to `claude_code.llm_request` trace spans; `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens` includes prompt cache tokens

title.zh-TW: 外掛清單新增可獨立拆裝的選用套件
title.en: Plugin Manifests Add Independently Removable Optional Packages

body.zh-TW: 裝了一個外掛卻被迫綁定一堆用不到的附帶功能，這對開發者與使用者都很困擾。外掛作者現在可以在外掛清單檔加上 `optionalDependencies`，列出選用的相依外掛。安裝主外掛時這些選用項目會跟著一起裝好，之後你還能隨時單獨停用或移除其中幾個，不會牽連原本的主體。⟦彷彿買沙發附贈了幾顆抱枕，雖然一起送到家，不想用時隨時可以個別收起來。⟧
body.en: Installing a plugin only to be forced into a bundle of unused extras is frustrating for both developers and users. Plugin authors can now add `optionalDependencies` to a plugin manifest to list optional dependent plugins. Those optional items install alongside the main plugin, and afterward you can disable or uninstall any of them on their own at any time without affecting the main plugin. ⟦It feels like buying a sofa that comes with throw pillows: they arrive together at your door, yet you can put away any pillow you do not want whenever you like.⟧

items.original: Added `optionalDependencies` to plugin manifests: plugins that install with the plugin listing them and can be disabled or uninstalled on their own

title.zh-TW: 確認選項改把「是」排第一，預設仍停在「否」
title.en: Confirmation Options Put "Yes" First While Defaulting to "No"

body.zh-TW: 執行 `/ide` 停止自動連線，或在子代理畫面呼叫 `/clear`、`/compact`、`/rewind`，確認視窗的選項順序已經調整。選項清單現在把「是」排在第一行，「否」排在下面，但預設游標依然停在「否」上面。如果照以前的習慣按「下」再按 `Enter`，現在選到的會是「否」。⟦好比遙控器把確認鍵和取消鍵上下對調，雖然一開始游標還是停在取消，但照舊按法往下就會選錯。⟧
body.en: When running `/ide` to stop auto-connect, or calling `/clear`, `/compact`, or `/rewind` in a subagent view, the option order in the confirmation dialog has changed. The option list now puts "Yes" on the first line and "No" below it, while the default cursor still starts on "No". If you press "Down" and then `Enter` out of old habit, you will now select "No". ⟦Suppose a remote control swaps the confirm and cancel buttons vertically: even though the cursor still starts on cancel, pressing down the old way picks the wrong one.⟧

items.original: Changed the questions for stopping auto-connect in `/ide` and for `/clear`, `/compact` or `/rewind` in a subagent's view to list Yes first; they still start on No, so Down then Enter now answers No

title.zh-TW: 調整 PermissionDenied 掛鉤的重試規則
title.en: Adjust Retry Rules for PermissionDenied Hook

body.zh-TW: `PermissionDenied` 這個 hook（特定事件發生時會自動觸發的小程式）回傳 `retry: true` 後，重試行為現在多了一道把關。Claude 只會在這個被拒絕的呼叫確實是你要求執行的情況下，才重新送出該次呼叫。⟦跟櫃檯補寄掛號信一樣，經手人得先確認這封信確實是你當初交寄的，才會幫忙再送一次。⟧
body.en: When the `PermissionDenied` hook (a small program triggered automatically when a specific event occurs) returns `retry: true`, retrying now has an extra safeguard. Claude only resends the refused call if you actually asked for that call. ⟦Resending registered mail at a post office counter works the same way: the clerk first verifies that you were the one who sent the letter before mailing it again.⟧

items.original: Changed what a `PermissionDenied` hook's `retry: true` tells Claude: make the refused call again only if you asked for that call

title.zh-TW: 受管理外掛市集日後將預設自動更新
title.en: Managed plugin marketplaces will auto-update by default

body.zh-TW: 給管理企業或團隊受控環境的管理員：如果團隊裡用受控設定統一列管外掛來源，請留意即將到來的規則調整。在 2026 年 11 月 30 日（含）之後的未來版本，列在 `extraKnownMarketplaces` 裡的外掛市集將會預設自動更新。如果有特定市集不希望自動升級，記得在該市集的設定項目加上 `"autoUpdate": false` 來手動關閉。⟦換成訂報紙來看，過了指定日期就會預設每天自動送達，不想收那一份得先貼上停送通知。⟧
body.en: For administrators managing enterprise or team-controlled environments: if your team uses managed settings to centrally list plugin sources, take note of an upcoming rule change. In a future release on or after November 30, 2026, plugin marketplaces listed in `extraKnownMarketplaces` will auto-update by default. If you do not want a specific marketplace to upgrade automatically, remember to add `"autoUpdate": false` to its entry to turn it off manually. ⟦Consider a newspaper subscription: after the set date, delivery happens automatically every day by default, and you have to post a stop-delivery notice first for any paper you do not want to receive.⟧

items.original: Changed in a future release, on or after November 30, 2026: plugin marketplaces in managed `extraKnownMarketplaces` will auto-update by default. To opt one out, set `"autoUpdate": false` on its entry

title.zh-TW: Windows 登錄檔受管理設定需先檢查再升級
title.en: Check Windows registry managed settings before upgrading

body.zh-TW: 如果你的環境靠系統原則統一派送設定，改版前得先確認裡面沒有填錯。使用 Windows 版且仰賴登錄檔寫入受管理設定的管理者，升級前請先檢查裡面的內容。由於 `HKLM` 裡的原則設定優先權高於本機的 `managed-settings.json`，登錄檔裡若有壞掉的設定值，可能讓程式無法啟動。⟦如同總部發的公告效力大過分店守則，要是總部那張告示印錯字，整間分店當天可能就開不了門。⟧
body.en: If your environment pushes settings centrally through system policies, make sure there are no mistakes in them before updating. Administrators on Windows who rely on the registry for managed settings should inspect those entries before upgrading. Because policy settings in `HKLM` take precedence over the local `managed-settings.json`, a broken value in the registry can prevent the program from starting. ⟦When headquarters issues a bulletin, it overrides local branch rules, so a misprint on that main notice can keep the entire branch from opening that day.⟧

items.original: Windows: Changed start-up with managed settings in the registry: check them before upgrading, as an `HKLM` policy outranks `managed-settings.json` and a broken value can stop the start

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 續接工作階段與長輸出修正
title.en: Code Mode session resume and long output fixes

body.zh-TW:
終端機的 Code Mode 這次修好了幾項影響執行與輸出的問題。

用 `--resume` 或 `--continue` 換別種權限模式接回工作階段，不會再丟失思考過程與提示詞快取；原本從需要詢問的模式起步，腳本仍會沿用該模式的限制。

腳本還在跑時輸入 `!` 或斜線指令，現在不會每秒狂送出一次請求。

長腳本輸出被砍掉中間那段的問題已修好，Claude 會拿到完整未裁切文字的檔案路徑。

搭配 `--bare` 執行時，Claude 現在能正常獲知腳本可呼叫哪些功能。

工具搜尋也顯示更多 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具說明，包含限制、格式與預設值。
body.en:
Code Mode in the terminal fixes several issues affecting execution and output.

Resuming a session in a different permission mode with `--resume` or `--continue` no longer loses thinking or the prompt cache; a session started in a mode that asks still keeps that mode's limits on scripts.

Typing `!` or a slash command while a script is still running no longer fires off a request every second.

Long script outputs no longer lose their middle section, and Claude now receives a file path to the full uncut text.

When running with `--bare`, Claude is now properly informed of what its scripts can call.

Tool search also displays more of an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tool's description, including its limits, formats, and defaults.

items.original:
Fixed Code Mode sessions resumed with `--resume` or `--continue` in another permission mode losing thinking and the prompt cache; one begun in a mode that asks keeps that mode's limits on scripts
Fixed Code Mode sending a request about every second when a `!` or slash command was typed while a script was running
Fixed Code Mode losing the middle of a long script output; Claude now gets a path to the uncut text (anthropics/claude-code#111373)
Fixed Code Mode with `--bare` not telling Claude what its scripts can call
Improved Code Mode tool search to show more of an MCP tool's description, with its limits, formats and defaults

title.zh-TW: 終端機窄矮視窗排版與清單顯示修正
title.en: Fixes for narrow and short terminal layouts and lists

body.zh-TW:
畫面空間拉得很小或壓得很扁時，按鍵提示、選項與文字很容易被裁掉或擠成一團。

窄視窗下的單行工具結果截斷後會補上刪節號。`/permissions` 的自動模式分頁修掉 Markdown 星號殘留，分岔技能被 hook 擋下的理由也不再印兩次。

`/diff` 在 24 到 26 行的視窗不會再隱藏按鍵提示或選不到檔案。在尚無提交紀錄的 Git 儲存庫中，以 `git add -N` 加入的檔案也會列出。

矮視窗初次設定時能看到足夠的佈景主題數量，`/usage` 等長畫面也不再錯亂。

全螢幕執行 `/bug` 時，長報告不再蓋住「是」與「否」按鈕，極矮視窗也看得到「是」。

全螢幕的 `/cd` 與 `/add-dir` 信任提示改用更少行數顯示選項，啟動提示有大量警告時也會保住資料夾路徑。
body.en:
When screen space is pulled narrow or squashed short, key hints, choices, and text can easily get cut off or cramped.

Single-line tool results in narrow windows now include an ellipsis when truncated. The Auto mode tab in `/permissions` no longer leaves stray Markdown stars, and a hook's reason for stopping a forked skill no longer prints twice.

`/diff` no longer hides key hints or fails to select files in windows of 24 to 26 rows. Files added with `git add -N` are also listed in Git repositories with no commits yet.

Short windows now show enough themes during first-run setup, and tall screens like `/usage` no longer come out garbled.

When running `/bug` in fullscreen, a long report no longer covers the "Yes" and "No" buttons, and "Yes" stays visible even in very short windows.

Fullscreen `/cd` and `/add-dir` trust prompts now display their choices in fewer rows, and the launch prompt keeps the folder path visible when it has many warnings.

items.original:
Fixed one-line tool results cut with no ellipsis in narrow windows, Markdown stars in the Auto mode tab of /permissions, and a hook's reason to stop a forked skill showing twice
Fixed `/diff` hiding its key hints and not selecting files in windows of 24 to 26 rows, and leaving out files added with `git add -N` in a repository with no commits
Fixed the first-run theme list showing too few themes in short windows, and /usage and other tall screens coming out garbled there
Fixed `/bug` in fullscreen hiding its Yes and No answers behind a long report, and Yes staying out of view in very short windows
Improved the folder trust prompts in short terminals: fullscreen `/cd` and `/add-dir` show their choices in fewer rows, and the prompt at launch keeps the folder path in view when it has many warnings

title.zh-TW: 外掛安裝卡死與更新殘留損毀修復
title.en: Fixes for hanging plugin installs and partial updates

body.zh-TW:
安裝或自動更新外掛時，幾個容易卡住或漏裝元件的狀況已經解決。

外掛更新如果半路中斷或失敗，不會再留下不完整的資料夾導致之後少掉技能或其他元件。

受管理設定需要人工核准卻無法跳出詢問時，`claude plugin install`、`marketplace add` 這類指令不會再毫無回應地卡死。

外掛自動更新通知現在會把順便新裝的相依外掛獨立列出來，跟原本更新的外掛分開顯示。
body.en:
Several issues that caused hangs or missing components when installing or auto-updating plugins have been resolved.

An interrupted or failed plugin update no longer leaves behind a partial folder that later loads with missing skills or other components.

Commands such as `claude plugin install` and `marketplace add` no longer hang with no output when managed settings require an approval that cannot be prompted.

The plugin auto-update notice now lists newly installed dependency plugins separately from the updated plugins.

items.original:
Fixed an interrupted or failed plugin update leaving a partial plugin folder that later loaded with skills or other components missing (anthropics/claude-code#102186)
Fixed `claude plugin install`, `marketplace add` and similar commands hanging with no output when managed settings needed an approval that could not be asked for
Improved the plugin auto-update notice to name plugins it newly installs as dependencies, separately from updated plugins

title.zh-TW: 子代理訊息傳遞與工作流代理收尾修復
title.en: Fixes for subagent messaging and Workflow agent cleanup

body.zh-TW:
把複雜工作拆給多個背景幫手平行處理時，以前偶爾會遇到訊息石沉大海，或做完事卻沒關掉資源的狀況。

當 Agent 工具的權限規則擋掉並丟棄傳給已結束子代理的排隊訊息時，Claude 現在會收到明確通知。

像 `Agent(model:*)` 這類限制子代理模型的權限規則，不會再誤擋傳給本版啟動且未指定模型的子代理後續訊息。

工作流代理交回報告後，它在背景執行的命令殼層（負責解讀與執行指令的程式）與 MCP 伺服器現在會正常結束，不再繼續殘留執行。
body.en:
When splitting complex work across multiple background helpers in parallel, messages could occasionally disappear or resources could stay open after the work finished.

Claude now receives a clear notification when permission rules on the Agent tool block and drop a queued message sent to a subagent that has already ended.

Permission rules restricting a subagent's model, such as `Agent(model:*)`, no longer mistakenly block follow-up messages to a subagent started on this version with no model specified.

After a Workflow agent hands back its report, its background shells (programs that interpret and run commands) and MCP servers now exit properly instead of staying running.

items.original:
Fixed Claude not being told when permission rules on the Agent tool dropped its queued message to a subagent that had already ended
Fixed a Workflow agent's background shells and MCP servers sometimes being left running after it handed back its report
Fixed a permission rule on a subagent's model, such as `Agent(model:*)`, blocking Claude's follow-up message to a subagent started on this version with no model named

title.zh-TW: 工具卡死、長回覆逾時與介面凍結修復
title.en: Fixes for hung tools, long reply timeouts, and freezes

body.zh-TW:
遇到連線卡住或等待回應時，終端機現在不會一直傻等甚至整片畫面凍結。

本機或 WebSocket 伺服器回傳格式有誤的訊息時，MCP 工具呼叫不再卡住長達 30 分鐘。

Claude 還在思考卻遇上回應靜止時，雲端工作階段的對話與子代理不再直接失敗，其他環境的長回覆也不再馬上逾時。Claude Code 會自動再重試一次請求。

讀取雲端或網路檔案卡住時，按 Esc 或點擊停止不再得等上約一分鐘甚至更久。

命令列工具收到部分特定回覆時不會再整段凍結，引用的文字也不會無故消失或重複出現兩次。
body.en:
When a connection stalls or waits for a response, the terminal no longer waits indefinitely or freezes up.

MCP tool calls no longer hang for up to 30 minutes when a local or WebSocket server returns a malformed reply.

When a reply goes silent while Claude is still thinking, turns and subagents in cloud sessions no longer fail immediately, and long replies elsewhere no longer time out right away. Claude Code automatically retries the request once.

Pressing Esc or clicking Stop when reading a cloud or network file stalls no longer waits about a minute or more.

The CLI no longer freezes on certain replies, and quoted text no longer disappears or shows up twice.

items.original:
Fixed MCP tool calls hanging for up to 30 minutes on some malformed replies from a local or WebSocket server
Fixed turns and subagents failing in cloud sessions, or timing out on long replies elsewhere, when a reply went silent while Claude was still thinking; Claude Code now tries the request once more
Fixed Esc and Stop waiting about a minute or more when the contents of a cloud or network file that Claude is reading stall
Fixed the CLI freezing on some replies, and quoted text sometimes going missing or showing twice

title.zh-TW: Windows 啟動、安裝與記憶體穩定修復
title.en: Windows startup, install, and memory stability fixes

body.zh-TW:
Windows 版的安裝流程、啟動穩定度與指令反應速度都有改善。

執行 `/desktop` 不會再抓到舊版 Claude Desktop 安裝檔，就算留有舊版資料夾也不會誤跳更新提示。

登錄檔裡的受管理設定即使包含日文等非 ASCII 字元，現在也能正常啟動。

電腦記憶體快用盡時可能發生的當機問題已經修好。

如果機器上沒有自訂的命令殼層啟動檔，工作階段裡第一道 Bash 指令也會跑得更快。
body.en:
Installation flow, startup stability, and command responsiveness have all been improved on Windows.

Running `/desktop` no longer downloads the older Claude Desktop installer, and it no longer triggers a false update prompt even if an older installation folder is left behind.

Startup now works properly even when managed settings in the registry contain non-ASCII characters such as Japanese.

A possible crash when the machine is nearly out of memory has been fixed.

The first Bash command in a session also runs faster on machines without custom shell start-up files.

items.original:
Windows: Fixed `/desktop` downloading the older Claude Desktop installer, and asking for an update when an older install's folder was left behind
Windows: Fixed a possible crash when the machine is almost out of memory
Windows: Fixed Claude Code refusing to start when managed settings in the registry contain non-ASCII characters such as Japanese (anthropics/claude-code#93280)
Windows: Improved the speed of the first Bash command in a session on machines with no custom shell start-up files

title.zh-TW: 修正部分外掛寫 FAT32 反覆詢權
title.en: Fixed repeated permission prompts on FAT32 drives

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上開著特定外掛工作階段，要把檔案寫進 FAT32 或 exFAT 格式的磁碟時，以前每寫一次就得重按一次允許。這個問題已經修好，不會再反覆跳出權限確認。
body.en: When writing files to FAT32 or exFAT drives during certain plugin sessions on Windows, you previously had to click Allow every single time. This issue is fixed, and permission prompts no longer pop up repeatedly.

items.original: Windows: Fixed file writes on FAT32 and exFAT drives asking for permission every time in some plugin sessions

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 遠端控制漏看新子代理步驟
title.en: Fixed Windows Remote Control missing new subagent steps

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 遠端連線用戶端追蹤任務進度，剛啟動的子代理已經開始工作，畫面上卻沒列出它做了什麼。這個問題已經修好。現在能正常顯示這些步驟。
body.en: When tracking task progress in a Windows Remote Control client, a newly started subagent could already be working without the screen listing what it did. This issue is fixed, and those steps now display properly.

items.original: Windows: Fixed Remote Control clients showing no steps for a new subagent

title.zh-TW: 修正無頭模式執行的推播通知狀態誤判
title.en: Fix PushNotification status misreporting in headless runs

body.zh-TW: 使用無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗介面的執行方式）跑排程等自動化任務時，`PushNotification` 過去在開跑第一分鐘會回報終端機處於活躍狀態。這個問題已經修好，現在它會改為正確回報是否請求了手機推播。
body.en: When running automated tasks such as scheduled runs in headless mode (running without a terminal window), `PushNotification` previously reported that the terminal was active during its first minute. This has been fixed, and it now accurately reports whether a mobile push was requested.

items.original: Fixed PushNotification telling a headless run, such as a scheduled one, that the terminal was active in its first minute, instead of saying whether a mobile push was requested

title.zh-TW: 修正 /install-github-app 跳步問題
title.en: Fix `/install-github-app` skipping steps

body.zh-TW: 跑 `/install-github-app` 找不到任何儲存庫又跳出設定警告後，程式過去會直接跳過選擇儲存庫的步驟。在工作流程清單或登入步驟想按 `Esc` 退回上一步，過去也按不動。這兩個問題都已經修好。
body.en: After running `/install-github-app` found no repositories and showed setup warnings, it previously skipped the repository selection step. Pressing `Esc` to go back from the workflow list or sign-in steps also failed to work. Both issues have been fixed.

items.original: Fixed `/install-github-app` skipping the repository step after setup warnings when no repository was found, and Esc not going back from its workflow list and sign-in steps

title.zh-TW: 修正對話壓縮遇特定 XML 標籤遺失摘要
title.en: Fix conversation compaction losing summary on certain XML tags

body.zh-TW: 長談到一半想幫對話瘦身，如果討論內容剛好引用到某些標記語法，濃縮後的重點以前可能會少掉一截。現在執行 `/compact` 或自動壓縮時，即使摘要裡出現特定 XML 標籤，內容也會完整保留。
body.en: When trimming down a long conversation midway through, the condensed summary could previously lose a section if the discussion happened to quote certain markup syntax. Now, when running `/compact` or auto-compact, the summary content stays intact even when specific XML tags appear in it.

items.original: Fixed /compact and auto-compact sometimes losing part of the conversation summary when the summary quoted certain XML tags

title.zh-TW: 修正遠端控制訊息錯位顯示在回覆上方
title.en: Fix Remote Control messages appearing above replies

body.zh-TW: 看到畫面上的文字快寫完、趕緊先送出下一句話時，對話順序以前有時會亂掉。在遠端控制遇到這種情況，剛送出的訊息不會再錯位顯示在該段回覆的上方。
body.en: When sending the next message just as the text on screen was finishing, the conversation order could previously get mixed up. In Remote Control, a newly sent message will no longer appear out of place above that reply.

items.original: Fixed a Remote Control message sometimes showing above the reply that was finishing when it was sent

title.zh-TW: 修正 Stop 掛鉤漏讀最後回覆的問題
title.en: Fix Stop hooks missing the last reply

body.zh-TW: 在 Claude Desktop 裡設定用來讀取對話逐字稿的 `Stop` hook，過去會漏掉最後一則回覆。這個問題已經修好，而且 `SubagentStop` hook 現在也會等這則回覆出現才執行。
body.en: In Claude Desktop, `Stop` hooks configured to read the conversation transcript previously missed the last reply. This has been fixed, and `SubagentStop` hooks now wait for that reply to appear before running.

items.original: Fixed Stop hooks that read the transcript missing the last reply in Claude Desktop; SubagentStop hooks now wait for it too

title.zh-TW: 修正筆記本特定輸出無法讀取
title.en: Fix failures reading notebooks with certain outputs

body.zh-TW:
拿一份包含執行結果的實驗筆記請 Claude 幫忙查看，以前遇到以下輸出會讀取失敗。

輸出為 `null`（沒有值），現在也能正常讀取。

錯誤輸出沒有 `traceback`（錯誤發生時的呼叫追蹤資訊），也不會再讓筆記本讀取失敗。
body.en:
When asking Claude to inspect a notebook containing execution results, it previously failed to read the following outputs.

Outputs that are `null` (no value) can now be read normally.

Error outputs without a `traceback` (call trace information from when an error occurred) will also no longer cause notebook reads to fail.

items.original: Fixed Claude failing to read a notebook that has a null output or an error output with no traceback

title.zh-TW: 修正回溯還原失敗後誤刪檔案的問題
title.en: Fix rewind deleting files after a failed restore

body.zh-TW: 使用回溯功能想把檔案退回先前的狀態，萬一還原步驟中途失敗，程式過去竟然還會把檔案刪掉。這個問題已經修好，還原失敗後不會再誤刪檔案。
body.en: When using rewind to roll files back to a previous state, if the restore step failed midway, it would previously delete the files. This has been fixed, so files are no longer deleted after a failed restore.

items.original: Fixed a rewind deleting files after a restore had failed

title.zh-TW: 修正自動模式拒停 /loop 導致繼續觸發
title.en: Fix auto mode refusing to stop `/loop`

body.zh-TW: 在自動模式下想請 Claude 停止一個 `/loop` 定時循環，它發出的停止呼叫過去有時會被拒絕，導致下一次排程醒來又繼續執行。這個問題已經修好。
body.en: In auto mode, when asking Claude to stop a scheduled `/loop`, its stop call was previously sometimes refused, causing the next scheduled wake-up to keep running. This has been fixed.

items.original: Fixed auto mode sometimes refusing Claude's call to stop a /loop, which left the next wake-up to fire

title.zh-TW: 修正掛鉤無法跨設定檔儲存技能允許規則
title.en: Fix hooks not saving skill allow rules across settings files

body.zh-TW: 使用 `PermissionRequest` hook 時，如果想把 `Skill(name:*)` 這類允許規則存到本機設定以外的設定檔，過去會存不進去。這個問題已經修好，現在可以正常寫入其他範圍的設定檔。
body.en: When using a `PermissionRequest` hook, trying to save allow rules like `Skill(name:*)` to a settings file outside local settings previously failed. This has been fixed, and they can now be written to settings files in other scopes.

items.original: Fixed PermissionRequest hooks not saving `Skill(name:*)` allow rules outside local settings

title.zh-TW: 修正團隊共用額度阻擋與核准通知文字
title.en: Fix team pooled budget block and approval prompt text

body.zh-TW: 被團隊共用群組預算擋住時，「Ask your admin」畫面過去卻會要你申請調高個人上限。如果管理員剛才已經核准了申請，它又會繼續顯示「Request sent」。這兩處錯誤提示都已經修好。
body.en: When blocked by your team's pooled group budget, the "Ask your admin" screen previously asked you to request raising your own limit. If an admin had just approved your request, it also continued to display "Request sent". Both incorrect prompts have been fixed.

items.original: Fixed "Ask your admin" asking to raise your own limit when your team's pooled group budget blocked you, and saying "Request sent" when an admin had approved your request in the last few minutes

title.zh-TW: 修正忙碌時按住說話導致口述中斷漏字
title.en: Fix hold-to-talk dictation cutting off when busy

body.zh-TW: Claude Code 正在忙著處理其他工作時，使用按住說話的語音口述過去會提早斷開，導致漏掉好幾個字。這個問題已經修好，忙碌期間按住口述不再提前中斷或漏字。
body.en: When Claude Code was busy handling other work, hold-to-talk voice dictation used to disconnect early and drop several words. This issue is now fixed, so hold-to-talk dictation no longer cuts off early or drops words while busy.

items.original: Fixed hold-to-talk dictation stopping early and losing words when Claude Code was busy

title.zh-TW: 修正自訂端點回傳無名工具呼叫導致當機
title.en: Fix crash from unnamed tool calls on custom endpoints

body.zh-TW: 接上自己架設的外部介面時，萬一對方回傳了一筆漏寫名稱的指令請求，整個對話以前會直接崩潰中斷。現在這種無名工具呼叫會改成回報錯誤並失敗，原本的工作階段則會繼續進行。
body.en: When connected to a self-hosted external interface, if it returned a command request missing a name, the entire conversation used to crash and stop. Now such an unnamed tool call fails with an error instead, and the existing session continues.

items.original: Fixed a crash when a custom API endpoint returned a tool call with no tool name; the call now fails with an error and the session continues

title.zh-TW: 修正 @file#10-12 標記附上整份檔案
title.en: Fix @file#10-12 mentions attaching the whole file

body.zh-TW: 提問時只想截取程式碼裡的某幾行來討論，以前系統卻常把整份文件通通塞進對話裡。現在用 `@file#10-12` 這類標記指定行數時，只會附上第 10 到 12 行的內容。
body.en: When asking a question and only wanting to pull a few lines of code to discuss, the system used to cram the whole document into the conversation. Now, when specifying line numbers with a mention like `@file#10-12`, only lines 10 to 12 are attached.

items.original: Fixed @-mentions written as `@file#10-12` attaching the whole file instead of those lines

title.zh-TW: 修正貼上成品邀請連結時誤讀的問題
title.en: Fix misreading pasted artifact invitation links

body.zh-TW: 收到別人分享的網址並直接貼進對話請 Claude 查看，它以前會誤判裡面的內容。現在遇到成品邀請連結，它會請你先接受邀請，再貼上該成品本身的連結。
body.en: When someone shared a link and you pasted it straight into the conversation for Claude to check, it used to misread the contents. Now, when given an artifact invitation link, it asks you to accept the invitation first and then paste the link to the artifact itself.

items.original: Fixed Claude misreading a pasted artifact invitation link; it now asks you to accept the invitation and paste the artifact's own link

title.zh-TW: 修正禁入暫存目錄且磁碟滿的 Bash 啟動
title.en: Fix Bash startup when temp access is blocked and disk is full

body.zh-TW: 你設定了檔案規則，不讓程式去碰電腦放暫時資料的空間，剛好這塊硬碟又沒有剩餘容量了。以前受沙盒（限制程式存取範圍的隔離環境）保護的 Bash 指令有時還是會無法啟動。現在這種情況下，Bash 指令也能正常啟動。
body.en: If you set file rules that keep programs out of the space where your computer stores temporary data, and that drive happens to have no free space left, Bash commands protected by a sandbox (an isolated environment that restricts what programs can access) previously still sometimes failed to start. Now, Bash commands start normally in this situation.

items.original: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands sometimes failing to start on a full temp disk, for sandboxes whose file rules keep commands out of the temp directory

title.zh-TW: 加速螢幕閱讀器模式長工作階段打字反應
title.en: Speed up typing in long screen reader sessions

body.zh-TW: 依賴語音輔助軟體操作並持續對話很久之後，以前敲鍵盤常會覺得卡頓延遲。現在開啟螢幕閱讀器模式輸入文字時，打字反應速度比以前快了不少，特別是在長工作階段裡更為有感。
body.en: After relying on voice assistive software for a long conversation, typing on the keyboard used to feel laggy and delayed. Now, when entering text with screen reader mode enabled, typing responds much faster than before, especially in long sessions.

items.original: Improved typing speed in screen reader mode, most of all in long sessions

title.zh-TW: 加快新開工作階段的啟動等待時間
title.en: Speed up startup wait for new sessions

body.zh-TW: 剛開完一個工作階段不久又再開新的，現在不會再重新等待載入模型清單。如果工作目錄不在 Git 儲存庫裡，而且底下也沒有 `.claude/settings.local.json` 設定檔，啟動時也不再浪費時間等 git 回應。
body.en: When you start a new session soon after opening another, it no longer waits to reload the model list. If the working directory is not inside a Git repository and has no `.claude/settings.local.json` config file under it, startup also stops wasting time waiting on git.

items.original: Improved start-up time: a session started soon after another no longer waits for the model list, and one outside a git repository without `.claude/settings.local.json` no longer waits on git

title.zh-TW: 縮短 /login 與主控台登入連結長度
title.en: Shorten /login and Console sign-in links

body.zh-TW: 要在終端機驗證帳號並把網址貼到瀏覽器開啟，過長的登入網址不方便查看。現在透過 `/login` 或 `claude auth login --console` 產生的主控台登入連結，變得短了許多。
body.en: When verifying your account in the terminal and pasting the URL into a browser, an overly long sign-in link is awkward to read. Now, the Console sign-in link generated by `/login` or `claude auth login --console` is much shorter.

items.original: Improved the Console sign-in link shown by /login and `claude auth login --console`: it is now much shorter

title.zh-TW: 成品清單標註網頁類型避免誤用連接器
title.en: Label web pages in artifact list to prevent connector misuse

body.zh-TW: Claude 查看你的成品清單時，清單現在會把網頁項目特別標註出來。這樣 Claude 就不太會誤拿 Claude Docs 連接器去試著開啟它。
body.en: When Claude checks your list of artifacts, the list now specifically marks web page items. That makes Claude less likely to mistakenly try opening one with the Claude Docs connector.

items.original: Improved Claude's list of your artifacts: it now marks web pages, so Claude is less likely to try opening one with the Claude Docs connector

title.zh-TW: VS Code 登出未確認撤銷時顯示警告
title.en: Show warning in VS Code when logout revocation is unconfirmed

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 點了登出卻趕著關視窗，萬一撤銷 `claude.ai` 登入權限的請求沒被確認，以前你可能以為已經登出乾淨了。現在遇到這種狀況，畫面上會跳出警告，並附上撤銷頁面的連結。⟦好比辦退租沒拿到電信商的解約簡訊，門市提醒你尚未收到確認，並遞給你一張印有退租網址的卡片。⟧
body.en: If you clicked log out in VS Code and rushed to close the window, and the request to revoke your `claude.ai` login wasn't confirmed, you previously might have assumed you were cleanly signed out. Now, when this happens, a warning appears on screen with a link to the revoke page. ⟦Canceling a phone plan without getting the carrier's cancellation text prompts the store clerk to warn you that confirmation hasn't arrived yet and hand you a card printed with the cancellation URL.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Added a warning and a link to the revoke page when you log out and the request to revoke your claude.ai login isn't confirmed

title.zh-TW: VS Code 送出過大內容前顯示提醒與建議
title.en: Show Notice and Advice Before Sending Oversized Content in VS Code

body.zh-TW: 不小心把整份超長的紀錄檔圈起來一起送出，常常等到畫面報錯才發現超載。現在於 VS Code 送出非常大的選取範圍或附加文字檔前，畫面上會先跳出提醒。萬一真的觸發「Prompt is too long」錯誤，下方也會明確點出是哪一塊內容過大，並告訴你接下來該怎麼處理。⟦就像電梯載重感應器先響起提醒，真超重停擺時，螢幕還會標出哪一箱貨物太重該先搬下來。⟧
body.en: When you accidentally select and send an entire massive log file, you often only discover the overload after an error appears on screen. Now, before sending a very large selection or attached text file in VS Code, a notice pops up first. If you do trigger a "Prompt is too long" error, advice underneath will clearly name the oversized part and tell you what to do next. ⟦An elevator weight sensor sounds a warning first, and if it stalls from an overload, the display points out which crate is too heavy to unload first.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Added a notice before sending a very large selection or attached text file, and advice under "Prompt is too long" that names the large part and what to do next

title.zh-TW: VS Code 筆記本儲存格可一按加入對話
title.en: Add VS Code Notebook Cells to Chat in One Click

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 看著筆記本裡報錯的那一格，想請 Claude 幫忙除錯卻得自己複製程式碼和底下那串錯誤輸出，相當麻煩。現在只要打開筆記本儲存格選單，就能看到新增的「Add Cell to Chat」選項。點下去就會連同該格內容與它的執行輸出或錯誤一併附進對話框。⟦就像看醫生時直接把檢驗報告連同紅字數值一併拍給醫師看，不用自己口述重唸一遍。⟧
body.en: Looking at a failing cell in a VS Code notebook, having to copy both the code and the error output underneath to ask Claude for debugging help is a hassle. Now, opening the notebook cell menu reveals a new "Add Cell to Chat" option. Clicking it attaches the cell along with its execution outputs or error directly to the chat box. ⟦Visiting a doctor, you hand over the lab report with its flagged numbers instead of reading everything aloud yourself.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Added "Add Cell to Chat" to the notebook cell menu, which attaches a cell with its outputs or error

Now those cards only show "Yes" and "No". Because there are fewer options, pressing `2` on those cards now answers "No" directly, so watch out before hitting keys out of habit. ⟦Crossing out the middle "don't ask again" box on a survey leaves only "yes" and "no", turning choice 2 straight into "no".⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Changed permission cards to show only Yes and No when `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` is set and the card would offer an allow rule; key 2 on those cards now answers No

title.zh-TW: VS Code 啟動面板與開啟對話反應加快
title.en: Faster VS Code Panel Startup and Chat Opening

body.zh-TW:
打開編輯器準備開始工作時，以前常得盯著轉圈圈等上好一陣子才能打字。這次在多種硬體與開發環境下，都縮短了 VS Code 啟動 Claude 面板與開啟對話的等待時間。

啟動速度與記憶體佔用皆有改善，面板與新分頁開得更快，新分頁首則訊息也更快收到回覆；Pro 與 Max 方案的資料夾信任對話框同樣提早出現。

裝了 Python 擴充功能但開啟不含 Python 檔案的新資料夾時，拿到第一則回覆的時間縮短了。

在 SSH、WSL 或容器等遠端視窗下，面板啟動、回覆顯示與重新開啟工作階段都變得更流暢。

如果電腦硬碟較慢或裝有防毒軟體掃描，對話啟動、從歷史紀錄開啟與重新啟動後恢復的速度也快了不少。
body.en:
When opening the editor to start work, you used to stare at a spinner for a while before you could type. This update cuts wait times for starting the Claude panel and opening chats in VS Code across a range of hardware and dev environments.

Startup speed and memory use are both improved, with the panel and new tabs opening faster and the first message in a new tab getting a reply sooner; on Pro and Max plans, the folder trust dialog also appears earlier.

When opening a new folder with no Python files while the Python extension is installed, the time to the first reply is shorter.

In remote windows (SSH, WSL, or containers), panel startup, reply display, and session reopening are all smoother.

On slower drives or systems with antivirus scanning, starting chats, opening them from history, and recovering after a restart are also noticeably faster.

items.original:
[VSCode] Improved the time to the first reply in a new folder when the Python extension is installed and the folder has no Python
[VSCode] Improved startup and memory use: the panel and new chat tabs open faster, a first message in a new tab is answered sooner, and on Pro and Max plans the folder trust dialog comes up sooner
[VSCode] Improved speed in remote windows (SSH, WSL, containers): the panel starts, replies appear and sessions reopen faster
[VSCode] Improved how fast chats start, open from history and come back after a restart on slow or antivirus-scanned disks

title.zh-TW: VS Code 長對話與閒置後操作互動加速
title.en: Faster VS Code Interactions in Long and Idle Chats

body.zh-TW:
對話越聊越長、改過許多檔案，或電腦放著閒置一下再回來問，VS Code 介面現在都比以前跟手。

開啟、還原或切回長對話的速度加快，尤其在修改過大量檔案或 git 較慢的環境下特別明顯。

長對話串流回覆期間打字與大量寫檔都更順暢，權限提示跳出更快，開啟無障礙輔助功能時送出訊息也不再嚴重凍結。

在記憶體偏低的機器上，對話閒置好一會兒後送出的第一則訊息，等待回應的時間已經縮短。

重新開啟舊對話時，差異比對畫面呈現得更快，並移除了原本沒作用的差異選單項目。
body.en:
When conversations grow long, many files have been edited, or your computer sits idle before you return to ask a question, the VS Code interface is now more responsive.

Opening, restoring, and switching back to long conversations is faster, especially when many files were edited or in environments where git is slow.

During streaming replies in long chats, typing and large file writes are smoother, permission prompts appear faster, and sending a message with accessibility support enabled no longer causes severe freezing.

On low-memory machines, the wait for a response to the first message sent after a chat has been idle for a while is now shorter.

When reopening old conversations, diff views render faster, and diff menu entries that did not work have been removed.

items.original:
[VSCode] Improved the speed of opening, restoring and switching back to long conversations, most of all with many file edits or where git is slow
[VSCode] Improved responsiveness in long chats: smooth typing and large file writes while a reply streams, faster permission prompts, and far less freezing on send with accessibility support on
[VSCode] Improved the time to a response for the first message after a chat has been idle for a few minutes on a machine that is low on memory
[VSCode] Improved how fast diffs appear in reopened conversations, and removed diff menu entries that did not work

title.zh-TW: VS Code @ 檔案選單排序與引用範圍修正
title.en: VS Code @ File Menu Sorting and Line-Range Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 對話框輸入 `@` 挑檔案或指定行數，選單顯示與附檔行為已經改進。

`@` 檔案選單現在會把目前已經開啟的編輯器分頁檔案排在最前面，最近使用過的置頂。

搜尋結果還沒傳回前，選單不再誤顯示「No files found」。工作區太大、無法搜尋所有檔案時，現在會明確告知這項限制。

Claude 用 `cd` 切換過資料夾後，`@` 標記不再附不到東西或抓錯同名檔案。

用 `Alt+K` 產生像 `@app.ts#5-10` 的行數範圍標記時，不會再送出整份檔案或前 2,000 行。

快速按 `Tab` 或 `Enter` 不會再插錯檔案；提示詞結尾是找不到對應檔案的 `@word` 時，按 `Enter` 也能正常送出。
body.en:
Typing `@` in the VS Code chat box to pick files or specify line ranges now works better, with improved menu display and file attachment behavior.

The `@` file menu now lists files from currently open editor tabs first, with the most recently used on top.

Before search results arrive, the menu no longer mistakenly shows "No files found". When a workspace is too large to search all files, it now clearly states this limitation.

After Claude changes folders with `cd`, `@`-mentions no longer fail to attach anything or pick the wrong file with the same name.

Using `Alt+K` to create a line-range mention such as `@app.ts#5-10` no longer sends the entire file or its first 2,000 lines.

Pressing `Tab` or `Enter` quickly no longer inserts the wrong file, and pressing `Enter` on a prompt ending in an `@word` with no matching file now sends properly.

[VSCode] Fixed Alt+K line ranges such as `@app.ts#5-10` sending the whole file, or its first 2,000 lines, instead of the selected lines

[VSCode] Improved the @ file menu to list the files of open editor tabs first, the most recently used on top

title.zh-TW: VS Code Escape 與快捷鍵誤觸中斷修正
title.en: VS Code Escape and Shortcut Misfire Fixes

body.zh-TW:
重新命名工作階段後按 `Escape` 不再中斷 Claude；用它關閉工作階段歷史紀錄後，打字焦點也不再消失。

在 MCP、Hooks 與 Memory 對話框的移除或刪除確認處，或側邊提問面板的按鈕與連結上，按 `Escape` 不再誤停 Claude。

書籤面板已展開且焦點在 Bookmarks 按鈕上，也適用這項修正。

權限提示上按 `Escape` 會取消，不再送出半截指令。

`Ctrl+1`、`Alt+1` 或 `Ctrl+Space` 不再誤觸開啟中的對話框，導致在回溯確認時還原檔案或切換 git 分支。

在 Windows 與 Linux 的聊天介面按 `Ctrl+J` 或 `Ctrl+O`，不再同時開啟終端機或開檔視窗。
body.en:
Pressing `Escape` after renaming a session no longer stops Claude, and closing session history with it no longer loses typing focus.

Pressing `Escape` at a Remove or Delete confirmation in MCP, Hooks, and Memory dialogs, or on a button or link in the side question panel, no longer stops Claude by mistake.

This fix also applies when the bookmarks panel is open and focus is on the Bookmarks button.

Pressing `Escape` on a permission prompt now cancels instead of sending a half-typed instruction.

`Ctrl+1`, `Alt+1`, or `Ctrl+Space` no longer accidentally triggers an open dialog, which could restore files during a rewind confirmation or switch the git branch.

Pressing `Ctrl+J` or `Ctrl+O` in the chat on Windows and Linux no longer also opens the terminal or the Open File dialog.

[VSCode] Fixed Escape stopping Claude at a Remove or Delete confirmation in MCP, Hooks and Memory dialogs, on a side question panel's button or link, and on the Bookmarks button with its panel open

[VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+J and Ctrl+O in the chat also opening VS Code's terminal or Open File dialog on Windows and Linux

title.zh-TW: VS Code 指令選單與輸入草稿保留修正

body.zh-TW:
打好的提示詞卻因為挑錯指令或切換模式讓文字瞬間歸零，這類輸入失誤已經解決。

在指令選單繼續打字篩選時，高亮度標記不會再停在舊項目上，按 `Enter` 不會再跑錯行。

點擊「/」按鈕選單指令時按 `Tab`，或點一下新手引導建議，原本已經寫好的訊息不會再被清空。

執行 `/tasks`、`/copy`、`/export` 或跳過 `/feedback` 後，草稿會保留。在計畫模式再輸入 `/plan` 也一樣。

按方向鍵選取歷史訊息時，不再直接蓋掉目前輸入的文字；改寫叫出來的舊提示詞，修改內容也會留著。

當像 `/api` 這類路徑與其他文字並排時，按 `Enter` 不會再改寫訊息或誤觸選單動作。直接輸入帶參數的斜線指令，執行時不會再漏掉參數。
body.en:
Input mishaps where typed prompts were suddenly wiped by picking the wrong command or switching modes are now resolved.

While typing to filter in the command menu, the highlight no longer stays on an earlier item, so pressing `Enter` no longer runs the wrong row.

Pressing `Tab` on a command in the "/" button's menu or clicking an onboarding suggestion no longer clears a message you already wrote.

Your draft is now preserved after running `/tasks`, `/copy`, `/export`, or skipping `/feedback`. The same applies when entering `/plan` while already in plan mode.

Using the arrow keys to browse message history no longer overwrites your currently typed text, and edits to a recalled prompt are kept.

When a path like `/api` appears alongside other text, pressing `Enter` no longer rewrites the message or triggers a menu action. Typed slash commands with arguments no longer drop their arguments when run.

[VSCode] Fixed typed text being lost after /tasks, /copy, /export, a skipped /feedback, or /plan while already in plan mode
[VSCode] Fixed the arrow keys replacing typed text with an old prompt while selecting, and dropping edits to a recalled prompt
[VSCode] Fixed Enter rewriting a message or running a menu action when a `/word` such as the path `/api` stands beside other text, and running a typed slash command without its arguments

title.zh-TW: VS Code 檔案連結與選取程式碼行為修正

在編輯器一邊看程式一邊跟 Claude 討論時，以前常遇到想帶入的片段沒跟上、或點開文件卻跳回第一行的狀況。現在對話裡的檔案路徑、連結跳轉與選取程式碼連動表現都已修正。

以檔案路徑或程式碼註解開頭的提示詞，現在能正常附帶選取的程式碼，也會出現分岔與回溯選單。

關閉某個檔案分頁後，之前在裡面選取的行數不會再黏在下一則訊息上一起送出。

除了筆記本以外，點擊對話裡的工作區檔案連結現在會依照你設定的編輯器關聯來開啟。

點開沒有標註行號的檔案連結時，已經開啟的檔案游標不會再硬被拉回第 1 行。
body.en:
When discussing code with Claude alongside the editor, selected snippets could fail to attach or clicking a file link could jump back to line 1. File paths, link navigation, and selected-code tracking in chat now behave properly.

Prompts that start with a file path or code comment now attach selected code properly and include the fork and rewind menu.

Closing a file tab no longer leaves previously selected lines attached to your next message.

Except for notebooks, clicking workspace file links in chat now opens them according to your configured editor associations.

Clicking a file link without a line number no longer moves the cursor of an already open file back to line 1.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed prompts that start with a file path or code comment being sent without the selected code and having no fork or rewind menu
[VSCode] Fixed file links in the chat ignoring your editor associations for files in the workspace, except notebooks (anthropics/claude-code#81482)
[VSCode] Fixed selected lines staying attached to your next message after their file's tab was closed
[VSCode] Fixed file links without a line number moving the cursor of an open file to line 1

title.zh-TW: VS Code 差異預覽與核准編輯通知修正
title.en: VS Code Diff Preview and Edit Approval Fixes

body.zh-TW:
審查 Claude 修改程式碼的差異比對分頁，顯示符號、分頁順序與退回通知都已經修正。

差異檢視裡的 `+` 與 `−` 符號現在正常顯示，不再變成空白方框。

筆記本與使用自訂編輯器的檔案在提出修改建議時，不再開出既沒有 Accept 或 Reject 按鈕、回應後又不會關閉的分頁。

多個子代理同時等待核准時，差異分頁會照順序開啟；對同一份檔案的後續編輯也不會再取消前面那筆修改。

退回部分建議修改，或在差異檢視中改動後接受時，Claude 不會再漏收到通知。
body.en:
In diff tabs for reviewing Claude's code edits, symbol rendering, tab ordering, and rejection notifications are now fixed.

The `+` and `−` signs in diff views now display properly instead of turning into empty boxes.

Proposed changes to notebooks and files using custom editors no longer open tabs that lack Accept or Reject buttons and stay open after you respond.

When multiple subagents wait for approval at the same time, diff tabs now open in order, and a later edit to the same file no longer cancels an earlier one.

Claude is no longer left uninformed when you reject part of a proposed edit or modify it in the diff view before accepting.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed empty boxes showing instead of the + and − signs in diffs (anthropics/claude-code#73069)
[VSCode] Fixed proposed changes to notebooks and files with a custom editor opening in a tab with no Accept or Reject that stayed open after the answer
[VSCode] Fixed diff tabs opening out of order when several subagents wait for approval, and a later edit to the same file cancelling an earlier one
[VSCode] Fixed Claude not being told when you reject part of a proposed edit or change it in the diff view before accepting

title.zh-TW: VS Code 符號連結存檔與編碼亂碼修正
title.en: VS Code Symlink Saving and Encoding Fixes

body.zh-TW:
透過特殊路徑開資料夾或處理非 UTF-8、右至左文字，存檔與顯示的資料保護更完整了。

開啟透過符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）連到的資料夾時，未儲存的變更不會再被漏掉，Claude 的修改也不會被你的下一次存檔蓋過去。

`files.encoding` 不是 UTF-8 時，建議差異裡顯示與儲存的非 ASCII 文字不會再變成亂碼。

處理含希伯來文、阿拉伯文或波斯文的內容時，核准後的編輯與寫入不再把右至左標記存成字面上的 `\u200F` 跳脫字元。
body.en:
Data protection for saving and displaying files is now more thorough when opening folders via special paths or working with non-UTF-8 and right-to-left text.

When opening a folder through a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location), unsaved changes are no longer missed, and Claude's edits are no longer overwritten by your next save.

When `files.encoding` is not UTF-8, non-ASCII text shown and saved in proposed diffs no longer turns garbled.

When handling content with Hebrew, Arabic, or Persian text, approved edits and writes no longer save right-to-left marks as literal `\u200F` escapes.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed unsaved changes being missed, and Claude's edit being overwritten by the next save, in a folder opened through a symlink
[VSCode] Fixed proposed diffs showing and saving garbled non-ASCII text when `files.encoding` is not UTF-8
[VSCode] Fixed approved edits and writes saving right-to-left marks as literal `\u200F` escapes on lines with Hebrew, Arabic or Persian text

title.zh-TW: VS Code 權限模式切換與上限提示修正
title.en: VS Code Permission Mode and Spend Limit Fixes

body.zh-TW:
調整授權設定、在確認視窗改寫指令或額度快用完時，以前常會跳出不對的模式或誤導人的訊息。現在權限模式切換、指令保留與花費上限提醒都已修正。

設定檔停用略過權限模式後，原本停在該模式的對話重開時會回到你一開始的權限模式，不會跳成自動模式。

Team 與 Enterprise 成員碰到花費上限時，不再被錯誤引導去執行無法從面板向管理員送出申請的 `/usage-credits`。

為了切換到 Plan 模式而按 `Shift+Tab` 經過 Edit 模式後，之後開新工作階段不會再自動停在 Edit 模式。

在權限確認提示上直接修改或貼上的指令，現在執行時會保留換行符號。

同一個面板裡背景執行中的對話若需要權限確認或等待回答，現在會正常跳出通知。
body.en:
Adjusting permission settings, editing commands in confirmation prompts, or hitting usage limits could previously trigger the wrong mode or misleading messages. Permission mode switching, command preservation, and spend limit alerts are now fixed.

When settings disable bypass permissions mode, a chat left in that mode now reopens in your initial permission mode instead of switching to Auto mode.

When Team and Enterprise members hit the spend limit, they are no longer misdirected to run `/usage-credits`, which cannot send a request to their admin from the panel.

Pressing `Shift+Tab` through Edit mode to reach Plan mode no longer causes new sessions to start in Edit mode automatically.

Commands edited or pasted directly on the permission prompt now keep their line breaks when executed.

When a conversation running in the background of the same panel needs permission or an answer, a notification now appears properly.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a chat left in bypass permissions mode reopening in Auto mode instead of your initial permission mode when settings disable bypass
[VSCode] Fixed the spend limit message telling Team and Enterprise members to run `/usage-credits`, which can't send a request to their admin from the panel
[VSCode] Fixed new sessions starting in Edit automatically after pressing Shift+Tab through it to reach Plan mode
[VSCode] Fixed an edited command on the permission prompt running without the line breaks that were typed or pasted into it
[VSCode] Fixed a missing notification when a conversation running behind another one in the same panel needs a permission or an answer

title.zh-TW: VS Code 面板排版、捲動追蹤與凍結修正
title.en: VS Code Panel Layout, Scroll, and Freeze Fixes

body.zh-TW:
VS Code 對話面板裡一批容易擋住按鈕、閃爍或畫面凍結的介面問題已經解決。

修掉了改寫提示詞後選取程式碼冒出原始標籤、模式按鈕閃爍「Manual」、斜線選單遮住反白列、登入圖片破圖，以及 Accept/Reject 列持續閃爍的問題。

寬表格與長路徑不會再被切斷，長錯誤訊息也不會蓋住關閉按鈕。Add MCP server 表單與 Chrome 對話框的錯誤提示不再跑出畫面外，外掛圖片也會配合編輯器佈景主題。

調整面板大小或隱藏後再重新顯示時，對話串會繼續跟隨 Claude 的最新回覆捲動。

部分 CSS 程式碼區塊與差異比較不會再讓整個對話面板凍結。

Focus 檢視模式裡的計畫核准卡片現在能正常顯示計畫註解。
body.en:
A batch of UI issues in the VS Code chat panel that blocked buttons, caused flickering, or froze the view have been resolved.

Fixed raw tags appearing for selected code under a reworded prompt, the mode button flashing "Manual", the slash menu hiding its highlighted row, a broken sign-in image, and a flickering Accept/Reject bar.

Wide tables and long paths are no longer cut off, and long error messages no longer cover their close button. Errors in the Add MCP server form and Chrome dialog no longer go out of view, and plugin images now follow the editor theme.

When resizing the panel or hiding and showing it again, the chat now keeps scrolling to follow Claude's latest reply.

Certain CSS code blocks and diffs no longer freeze the entire chat panel.

Plan comments now display properly on the plan approval card in Focus view.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed raw tags for selected code under a reworded prompt, the mode button flashing Manual, the slash menu hiding its highlighted row, a broken sign-in image, and a blinking Accept/Reject bar
[VSCode] Fixed wide tables and long paths cut off, long errors hiding their close button, errors out of view in the Add MCP server form and Chrome dialog, and plugin pictures ignoring the editor theme
[VSCode] Fixed the chat no longer following Claude's reply after the panel was resized, or hidden and shown again
[VSCode] Fixed the chat panel freezing on some CSS code blocks and diffs
[VSCode] Fixed plan comments not showing on the plan approval card in Focus view

title.zh-TW: VS Code 分岔與程式碼回溯安全修正
title.en: VS Code Fork and Code Rewind Safety Fixes

body.zh-TW:
想從舊對話開出一條新分支試試不同做法，或把改壞的程式退回上一步時，以前常會不小心蓋掉計畫檔或卡住介面。現在在 VS Code 進行分岔或回溯程式碼都更安全。

分岔出去的新對話不會再覆蓋原本對話的計畫檔案；如果分岔或回溯時無法複製計畫檔，現在會跳出警告。

較晚送出的提示詞與輸入框不會再蓋住回溯程式碼的對話框，檢查完檔案後游標焦點也不再從「Never mind」跳到「Rewind」。

在 Claude 還在執行期間按回溯程式碼後，它不會再繼續編輯檔案。

長對話每次進行分岔或回溯時，記憶體不會再一路往上飆直到重載視窗才釋放。

即使 Claude 的工作階段程序已經結束，回溯功能也不會再跳出「No active session」。
body.en:
When branching off an older conversation to try a different approach or rolling back broken code, it used to be easy to accidentally overwrite a plan file or freeze the interface. Forking conversations and rewinding code in VS Code are now safer.

A forked conversation will no longer overwrite the original conversation's plan file, and a warning now appears if a fork or rewind cannot copy the plan file.

Later prompts and the message box no longer cover the Rewind code dialog, and focus no longer jumps from "Never mind" to "Rewind" after it finishes checking files.

Claude no longer continues editing files after you rewind code while it is working.

Memory no longer grows with each fork or rewind of a long conversation until the window is reloaded.

Rewind no longer shows "No active session" even after Claude's session process has ended.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a forked conversation overwriting the original conversation's plan file; a fork or rewind that can't copy the plan now shows a warning
[VSCode] Fixed later prompts and the message box covering the Rewind code dialog, and focus jumping from "Never mind" to "Rewind" when it finishes checking files
[VSCode] Fixed Claude continuing to edit files after you rewind code while it is working
[VSCode] Fixed memory growing with each fork or rewind of a long conversation until the window was reloaded
[VSCode] Fixed Rewind showing "No active session" after Claude's process had ended

title.zh-TW: VS Code 對話清單、回復與排隊狀態修正
title.en: VS Code Session List, Resume, and Queue Status Fixes

body.zh-TW:
從歷史紀錄接回舊對話、排隊送訊息或切分頁，工作階段狀態不會再卡住或遺失。

從歷史紀錄恢復工作階段的分頁，執行重新命名、標記為未讀或加入群組時不再誤報「still connecting」。

遇到 API 錯誤、「Prompt is too long」或執行斜線指令後，上下文用量指示器不會再消失。

排在待執行 `/clear` 指令後面的訊息不會再無故遺失。

當 Claude 程序剛結束或還在啟動時切換模型，下一則訊息現在會確實套用你剛選的模型。

工作階段清單不會再一次打開所有逐字稿，在專案紀錄很多時不再拖慢擴充功能或漏掉部分工作階段。
body.en:
When resuming an older conversation from history, queuing messages, or switching tabs, session state no longer gets stuck or lost.

Tabs that resumed a session from history no longer falsely report "still connecting" when you use Rename, Mark as Unread, or Add to Group.

The context usage indicator no longer disappears after an API error, "Prompt is too long", or a slash command.

Messages queued behind a pending `/clear` command are no longer lost.

When you switch models just as Claude's process has ended or while it is still starting, the next message now applies the model you picked.

The session list no longer opens every transcript at once, preventing it from slowing down extensions or leaving out sessions in projects with many records.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed Rename, Mark as Unread and Add to Group saying "still connecting" on a tab that resumed a session from its history
[VSCode] Fixed the context usage indicator disappearing after an API error, "Prompt is too long", or a slash command
[VSCode] Fixed a message queued behind a queued /clear being lost
[VSCode] Fixed a model pick being ignored for the next message when Claude's process had ended or was still starting
[VSCode] Fixed the session list opening every transcript at once, which stalled the editor's extensions and could leave sessions out in projects with many sessions

title.zh-TW: VS Code 外掛管理介面與設定檔載入修正
title.en: VS Code Plugin Manager and Settings Loading Fixes

body.zh-TW:
管理外掛或讀取 `settings.json` 切換模型，幾處阻礙排錯與設定的問題已經修好。

Manage Plugins 搜尋不到結果時不會再把搜尋框弄不見或毫無提示，可用外掛清單載入失敗時也會明確說明。

即使 `settings.json` 是空的或開頭帶有位元組順序記號，切換模型也不再跳出「Settings file is not valid JSON」而失敗。

就算 Claude Code 啟動很慢或啟動失敗，Manage Plugins 介面現在依然能正常載入，方便你先關掉卡住啟動的外掛。
body.en:
Several issues that blocked troubleshooting and configuration when managing plugins or reading `settings.json` to switch models have been fixed.

Manage Plugins no longer loses its search box or shows no message when a search has no match, and it now clearly reports when the list of available plugins fails to load.

Switching models no longer fails with "Settings file is not valid JSON" when `settings.json` is empty or starts with a byte order mark.

Manage Plugins now loads normally even when Claude Code is slow to start or fails to start, so you can turn off a plugin that blocks startup.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed Manage Plugins losing its search box or showing no message when a search has no match, and not saying that the list of available plugins failed to load
[VSCode] Fixed switching models failing with "Settings file is not valid JSON" when settings.json is empty or starts with a byte order mark
[VSCode] Fixed Manage Plugins not loading when Claude Code is slow to start or fails to start, so a plugin that blocks startup can be turned off

title.zh-TW: VS Code 連線、語音與登入提示改善
title.en: VS Code Connection, Voice, and Sign-In Prompt Improvements

body.zh-TW:
語音中斷或驗證被拒，VS Code 現在會給出更準確的畫面提示。

語音口述的連線如果中斷或根本沒連上，不會再誤報「沒辨識到語音」，現在會清楚告知連線已中斷或無法連線。

當閘道器送來沒有名稱的工具呼叫時，對話面板不會再因此顯示「Something went wrong」。

當請求遭到拒絕而跳出登入畫面時，畫面現在會主動說明打開登入頁的原因。
body.en:
When voice dictation drops or authentication is refused, VS Code now gives more accurate on-screen prompts.

If the voice dictation connection drops or never opens, it no longer falsely reports "no speech was recognized" and now clearly states that the connection was lost or could not connect.

The conversation panel no longer shows "Something went wrong" when a gateway sends a tool call with no name.

When the sign-in screen opens because a request was refused, it now explains why it opened.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed voice dictation saying no speech was recognized when its connection closed or never opened; it now says the connection was lost or couldn't connect
[VSCode] Fixed the panel showing "Something went wrong" for a conversation in which a gateway sent a tool call with no name
[VSCode] Improved the sign-in screen to say when it opened because a request was refused

title.zh-TW: 修正 Electron 與擴充測試無法啟動
title.en: Fix Electron Apps and Extension Tests Failing to Start

body.zh-TW: 透過 Claude、hook 或 MCP 伺服器啟動 Electron 應用程式或擴充功能測試，過去會啟動失敗。這個問題已經修好，不過把 VS Code 當作 Node 來執行的包裝腳本、hook 或伺服器，現在必須明確設定 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`。
body.en: Starting Electron apps or extension tests from Claude, a hook, or an MCP server previously failed. This issue is fixed, though any wrapper script, hook, or server that runs VS Code as Node must now explicitly set `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`.

items.original: [VSCode] Fixed Electron apps and extension tests failing to start from Claude, a hook or an MCP server; a wrapper, hook or server that runs VS Code as Node must now set `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`

title.zh-TW: VS Code 修正啟動中關分頁導致新分頁空白
title.en: VS Code Fix for Blank Tabs After Closing During Startup

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡，Claude 還在啟動時如果直接關閉分頁，之後再開新的 Claude 分頁過去會整片空白，連側邊欄也跟著載入失敗。這個問題已經修好，現在重開分頁與側邊欄都能正常顯示。
body.en: In VS Code, closing a tab while Claude was still starting previously caused new Claude tabs opened afterward to stay blank and the side bar to fail to load. This issue is fixed, so reopened tabs and the side bar now display normally.

items.original: [VSCode] Fixed new Claude tabs staying blank and the side bar failing to load after closing a tab while Claude was still starting

title.zh-TW: 修正 VS Code 面板快速連點誤觸問題
title.en: Fix Accidental Triggers from Quick Double Clicks in VS Code Panel

body.zh-TW: 滑鼠手速太快連按兩下時，第二下以前常會剛好點到新跳出來的按鈕或清單列，或是在上下文用量圓圈上不小心啟動第二次壓縮。這個 VS Code 面板的誤觸問題已經修好。
body.en: When double-clicking quickly, the second click previously could press a newly appeared button or row, or accidentally start a second compaction on the context usage circle. This accidental trigger issue in the VS Code panel is now fixed.

items.original: [VSCode] Fixed a quick double click in the panel pressing a button or row that appeared after the first click, or starting a second compaction from the context usage circle

title.zh-TW: 修正輸入 @ 遺留分頁輔助程序問題
title.en: Fix Leftover Tab Helper Processes When Typing @

body.zh-TW: 沒連瀏覽器就在 VS Code 輸入 `@`，每個分頁過去都會留下一支輔助程序繼續在背景跑。這個問題已經修好，除非當下連不上 Claude in Chrome 的服務，否則不再遺留程序。
body.en: Typing `@` in VS Code without a browser connected previously left a helper process running in the background per tab. This issue is fixed, and processes are no longer left behind unless Claude in Chrome's service cannot be reached.

items.original: [VSCode] Fixed typing @ leaving a helper process running per tab when no browser is connected, except when Claude in Chrome's service can't be reached
